title: The asset tab's Asset on Site toggle keeps the lead technician
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Two technicians named exactly "Ana Alpha" and "Ben Bravo" (the expected results name them) at this location: Role Technician, a Department, Time Clock on.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Toggle Lead" (used by this case only) with one contact and the asset TRK-201.
  • One Approved work order [WO-1] for TRK-201 with Lead Technician "Ana Alpha".

Setup

  1. Your initials > Settings > Staff: make sure technicians named exactly "Ana Alpha" and "Ben Bravo" exist (New Staff Member > First Name Ana, Last Name Alpha / First Name Ben, Last Name Bravo > Role Technician > Departments any one > Location Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > Time Clock on > Save & Close).
  2. Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Toggle Lead" > Save (the customer page opens). Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name "ZZAUTOTEST", Last Name "Contact" > Save. Assets tab > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 2022 > Make: type "Freight" and pick Freightliner > Model: type "M2" and pick it > Unit "TRK-201" > Save (Contact and Make are required).
  3. Work Orders > Create Work Order > New Work Order: Customer = "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Toggle Lead" > Asset = TRK-201 > Save. If a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open. Record the number shown at the top left as [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-760").
  4. In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Close.
  5. On [WO-1], on the status card at the left, click Lead Technician and pick "Ana Alpha". (Lead Technician is a dropdown only once the work order is Approved; while it is an Estimate it reads "Unassigned" and cannot be changed.) The choice saves at once.
  6. Check the setup worked: the asset page of TRK-201 > Work Orders tab lists [WO-1]; [WO-1] shows Lead Technician Ana Alpha.
custom_steps:
1. Click Customers in the top menu, open "ZZAUTOTEST Asset Tab Toggle Lead", click its Assets tab, click the TRK-201 row and click its Work Orders tab.
  2. In the [WO-1] row click the Asset on Site toggle (the location pin in the On Site column).
  3. Reload the page and read the Asset on Site value (green pin = on site, faded red = not).
  4. Open [WO-1] and read Lead Technician.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the toggle flips with no error message.
  • Step 3: the new Asset on Site value is kept.
  • Step 4: Lead Technician still reads "Ana Alpha".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, High 4; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §2; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply High 4: “The asset-on-site toggle no longer sends the lead; the lead should stay unchanged after a toggle.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
